caption:
Spaghetti Bolognese, My Way! 
high protein | dinner for two | 30 minute recipe | date night | meal prep friendly 

C: 56 | F: 15 | P: 45
Calories: 516 per serving
Serves 3

Ingredients: 
1 tbsp oil
6 garlic cloves minced + 1 tsp garlic paste for that extra zing
1 onion, finely chopped
1 - 2 carrots, finely chopped, optional 
1 capsicum, finely chopped
1 box / 200 grams buttom mushroom
450 grams chicken kheema 
1 tbsp tomato paste
4 - 5 tomatoes, make a puree in the blender
3/4 cup vegetable stock or 1/2 cup water, whatever is available for you
1 tbsp black pepper
1 tbsp dried basil, use fresh chopped basil if available | oregano works great too , adjust salt though 
1 tbsp red chilli flakes
handful of chopped coriander leaves / basil or parsley if you fancy 
140 grams pasta of choice 
grated cheese, as much as you desire :) 

Method:
add the oil to the pan followed by the garlic and onions
add in the carrots ( if using ), saute and then add mushrooms and cook till water evaporates
add in the capsicum and cook for 2 minutes
( if using a chopper like me, i just add the garlic, onions, mushroom, capsicum to a food processer and mince ) 
add in the chicken kheema and stir together
mix in the tomato paste and tomato puree
add in the vege stock and salt + black pepper + basil + red chilli flakes and coriander
cover and allow to simmer for 15 - 20 minutes, ensure the kheema is fully cooked
add in the al dente pasta and let it simmer in the pasta for 5 minutes ( i like to use like 70% cooked pasta and let it cook in the bolognese - this adds so much flavour to the pasta and helps thicken the mix
plate up your pasta and top with cheese of your choice :) 

Pro Tips: 
you personally might find this pasta to be a little on the wetter side, just whack your flame on high for 5-6 minutes and it will dry out slightly :) 
reduce the amount of pasta to reduce the carbs, increase mince for higher protein
